# Contract: Public Artifact URLs

These URLs/paths are part of the public surface (Constitution §VIII). Renaming any `dist/` file is a major change.

## jsDelivr (primary)

```html
<!-- testing: major-pinned -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/newbrush@1/dist/newbrush.min.css">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/newbrush@1/dist/newbrush.min.js" defer></script>

<!-- production: exact-pinned + SRI (hash generated by scripts/sri.ts) -->
<link rel="stylesheet"
      href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/newbrush@1.0.0/dist/newbrush.min.css"
      integrity="sha384-…" crossorigin="anonymous">

<!-- prototyping only: in-browser JIT -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/newbrush@1/dist/play.js"></script>
```

## unpkg / cdnjs

```text
https://unpkg.com/newbrush@1/dist/newbrush.min.css
https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/newbrush/1.0.0/newbrush.min.css
```

## dist/ layout (stable)

| File | Purpose |
| ---- | ------- |
| `newbrush-core.css` / `.min.css` | reset + tokens + base + layout |
| `newbrush.css` / `.min.css` | core + all components |
| `newbrush-full.css` / `.min.css` | + curated utilities preset (CDN default for prototyping) |
| `components/<name>.css` | per-component cherry-pick (requires core) |
| `themes/<name>.css` | extra themes (`dark`, `contrast`, brand samples) |
| `newbrush.min.js` / `newbrush.esm.js` | optional enhancements |
| `play.js` | in-browser JIT (dev only) |
| `manifest.json` | machine-readable catalogue (tokens, utilities, components) |
| `tokens.json` / `tokens.js` / `tokens.d.ts` | resolved tokens |
| `*.map` | source maps |

## Release download assets

`newbrush-<ver>-dist.zip`, `newbrush-<ver>-source.zip`, `SHA256SUMS`, `newbrush-<ver>.cdx.json` (SBOM).
